Where will #MeToo take its survivors? Starting Fri we publish #PolisAnthologies feat Apoorva K, Jhuma Sen, Kruthika NS, Nayema Nasir, Raya Sarkar, Rollie Mukherjee, Suchitra Vijayan, Vasundhara Sirnate. What comes after #MeToo? @project_polis. Read, share!

When serious ethical breaches go unchecked by those in position of responsibility, they create a political economy of silence. First essay in our #MeToo Series. By @suchitrav. Read&Share! @project_polis, @IndiaMeToo, #Art, #Photography, #India, #TimesUp
https://t.co/mkRwjZOGBL

Skewed in favour of powerful, the language, medium, and space available for survivors to speak of sexual harassment remain inadequate. This cognitive poverty is not an anomaly. It's a function of culture that produces it. @suchitrav, @project_polis, #MeToo https://t.co/jgpxX2ZBAv

A culture that elevates the storyteller above the story and uses the banality of bearing witness as an excuse to produce extractive work needs to be challenged. Second essay in @project_polis #MeToo Series by @suchitrav. @IndiaMeToo, #India, #TimesUp 
https://t.co/rvaRkTaFpV

What function does the nakedness of the black woman serve? Are the experiences of an African person in Khirkee the same as those of an African-American tourist in Kasauli? Second essay in @project_polis #MeToo ​Series by @suchitrav. @IndiaMeToo, #India.  https://t.co/rvaRkTaFpV

When a project around nudity is equated with freedom, does a woman choosing not to disrobe then live in permanent unfreedom? ...when women in India especially Dalit/Adivasi are regularly stripped as punishment? ⁦@suchitrav⁩, @project_polis, #MeToo⁠. https://t.co/rvaRkTaFpV

“I asked him what’s your idea, what’s your concept...?” Shantaram suggested he’d like to photograph her on the hotel rooftop... casually suggested, “If you don’t mind being nude, that,d be good.” By @suchitrav. @project_polis #MeToo⁠ Series, @IndiaMeToo. https://t.co/rvaRkTaFpV

As part of ⁦@project_polis⁩ #MeToo series, a graphic essay using medium of art to understand what this moment means to young women and how they navigate and narrate their stories amidst a culture of fear and silence. ⁦@kruthika_ns⁩, Apoorva K. https://t.co/uRgaZpN1fy
